description: This file defines the MediaLibraryState class, a value object managing the state of the media library in Drupal, including parameters like opener ID, allowed types, selected type, remaining slots, and hash validation.

classes.name: MediaLibraryState
classes.description: A value object for managing the state of the media library, including parameters validation, hash generation, and retrieval from requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with parameters and validates required fields, then sets a hash.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new MediaLibraryState object with specified parameters.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Creates a MediaLibraryState object from an HTTP request, validating the hash.

methods.name: validateRequiredParameters
methods.description: Validates essential parameters like opener ID, allowed types, selected type, and remaining slots.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Generates a hash based on the state parameters for validation.

methods.name: isValidHash
methods.description: Checks if a given hash matches the current state hash.

methods.name: getOpenerId
methods.description: Returns the media library opener service ID.

methods.name: getAllowedTypeIds
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed media type IDs.

methods.name: getSelectedTypeId
methods.description: Returns the currently selected media type ID.

methods.name: hasSlotsAvailable
methods.description: Determines if additional media items can be selected.

methods.name: getAvailableSlots
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining slots for media selection.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts for the object.
